name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.4.2
summary: Fix Sysvol peer replication daemon-to-daemon authorization via X-Zclock-Sync-Secret header
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.4.2:
* **Sysvol Peer Sync Authorization Fix:** Replaced global router-level session authentication requirement in api/routers/sysvol.py with fine-grained endpoint security. Added verify_sysvol_sync_access() to allow zclock-sysvold background replication requests using constant-time X-Zclock-Sync-Secret header validation matching /etc/zclockid/sysvol_secret or configured partner shared secrets.
* **Endpoints Restored:** Peer DC manifest comparison (GET /manifest) and file payload replication (GET/POST /file) now succeed with HTTP 200 rather than HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
* **Admin Role Protection:** Management endpoints (/status, /partners, /sync-now, /reset-ntacl) remain strictly protected by readonly/operator role session checks.
